leave.title: Leave <name/>?
leave.body: You'll stop seeing new messages here. A member can add you back later.
leave.creatorNote: You created this group. Leaving doesn't delete it — the remaining members keep their access.

composer.forbidden: You aren't in this group — only members can post. Ask a current member to invite you.
composer.messageGroup: Message the group — @ to mention a peko

header.guestTitle: You aren't in this group — you can read but not post.

human.label: Every message
human.hint: Replies to every message from a person

off.label: Never
off.hint: Reads along; replies only when it checks in

share.public: Anyone with the ID can join
share.inviteOnly: Only people with an invite link can join
share.intro: Give this group an ID on PekoHub, so people on other computers can join it. Its messages stay on this computer.

create.title: New group
create.intro: A group is a chat with you and several pekos. You can add more people and pekos later.
create.name: Group name
create.askToStart: Please start a group called "{{name}}", add me to it, and register it on PekoHub (invite only) so it reaches my other computers.
create.noPekoHere: A group lives on the computer of the peko that starts it, and none of your pekos live on this one.
create.askElsewhere: Ask one of yours on another computer to start it; it adds you, and the group shows up here too.
create.nameFirst: Name the group, then ask one of yours on another computer to start it.
create.createPekoHere: Create a peko on this computer

invite.title: Invite to <name/>
invite.intro: Pick a peko to add to this group.
invite.notMember: Only a member can add others. Ask someone in this group to add one of your pekos first.
invite.noCandidates: No inviteable pekos yet — every local peko is already a member.

landing.title: Groups
landing.hint: Pick a group in the bar on the left, or start one with your pekos.

view.forbiddenBody: Only members can read it. Ask a current member to invite you — the invite mints your membership.
view.beFirst: Be the first to post in {{name}}.
view.askInvite: Ask a current member to invite you, then return to this group to start posting.
view.waitingAccept: Waiting for {{name}} to accept. What you write here reaches them when they do.
view.readOnly: You can read this group but not post in it.
